title: Korean Potato Salad
shortDescription: Tender potatoes are mashed coarsely with firm-cooked egg, salted cucumber, carrot, apple, and commercial mayonnaise for a creamy Korean restaurant-style side.
culturalContext: Korean potato salad is a creamy modern banchan influenced by Western-style salads and often includes vegetables, fruit, egg, or ham. Additions and sweetness vary.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}

ingredients.preparation: scrubbed, peeled, and cut into chunks

instructions.heading: Wash and prepare
instructions.action: Wash potatoes, cucumber, carrot, and apple under running water; prepare on clean boards.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Produce is clean and evenly cut.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep ready-to-eat produce away from raw eggshells.

instructions.heading: Cook potatoes
instructions.action: Boil potato chunks until a tester enters easily; drain well and mash coarsely.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Potatoes are fully tender with no hard center.
instructions.safetyNote: Avoid steam burns and use a clean tester.

instructions.heading: Hard-cook eggs
instructions.action: Cook eggs until whites and yolks are firm, cool in ice water, peel with clean hands, and chop.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Whites and yolks are fully firm.
instructions.safetyNote: Discard cracked or contaminated eggs and wash hands after shell contact.

instructions.heading: Salt cucumber and cool
instructions.action: Salt cucumber briefly and squeeze dry. Spread potatoes in a shallow tray until no longer hot, then refrigerate to cool.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Potatoes are cooled and cucumber is dry.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not mix mayonnaise into hot potatoes or leave cooling food at room temperature beyond safe limits.

instructions.heading: Mix cold
instructions.action: Combine cooled potatoes, egg, cucumber, carrot, apple, mayonnaise, sugar, remaining salt, and pepper with clean utensils.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Salad is creamy with visible pieces.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep mayonnaise and finished salad at or below 40°F / 4°C.

instructions.heading: Chill and serve
instructions.action: Cover, refrigerate at least 30 minutes, and portion with a clean utensil.
instructions.safetyNote: Discard portions held above refrigeration limits or contacted by shared/raw utensils.

grillSetup: Not applicable; this banchan is prepared without a grill.
targetInternalTemperature: Cook shell eggs until yolks and whites are firm and potatoes until fully tender; cool ingredients promptly before mixing.
visualDonenessCues: Egg whites and yolks are firm
foodSafetyNotes: Use clean uncracked refrigerated eggs and cook until firm.
Use commercial pasteurized mayonnaise and keep refrigerated.
Cool potatoes promptly in a shallow layer before mixing.
Keep finished salad at or below 40°F / 4°C and discard after unsafe holding.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains egg; commercial mayonnaise labels may declare additional allergens, so verify the exact product.

substitutions: Omit egg only as a documented adaptation after retesting moisture and seasoning.
ingredientSourcing: Choose firm potatoes without green portions or sprouts and commercial pasteurized mayonnaise.
makeAhead: Prepare up to 1 day ahead and keep covered and refrigerated.
storage: Refrigerate promptly at or below 40°F / 4°C and use within 3 days pending review.
leftovers: Discard table-exposed portions and keep only clean continuously refrigerated salad.
servingSuggestions: Serve cold in small portions with grilled foods.

faq.question: Why cool potatoes before mayonnaise?
faq.answer: It limits warm holding and protects the cold emulsion.

faq.question: Can the eggs be soft?
faq.answer: No. This draft requires firm whites and yolks.

metaDescription: Make creamy Korean potato salad with tender potatoes, firm-cooked egg, pasteurized mayonnaise, shallow cooling, refrigeration, and clean service.
